text:
emily: Hey team — proposal: webinar on 'Serving LLMs at scale: real world tradeoffs' next Tues 10am PT. Short (45m) with live demo + Q&A. Thoughts on speakers + run order? :sparkles:
raj: +1 topic. I can do a short product overview (5-7m) and talk about dedicated vs hosted routing.
chris: happy to handle slide deck and 1–2 visual benchmarks. can we keep the demo simple? last time network hiccup killed us. :grimacing:
tahira: I can host and manage Q&A. Suggest we route leads to AE queue with a 'webinar' tag. Can ops/sales confirm routing?
emily: good call. draft run-of-show: intro (emily 2m) -> product (raj 7m) -> benchmark visuals (chris 8m) -> live demo (sam_devrel 12m) -> customer panel (optional 8m) -> Q&A (8m). We should cut demo to 10 if panel on.
raj: for demo fallback, prepare a recorded video clip and a static endpoint snapshot. Also a small local model fallback (quantized) to show degraded but working results.
chris: slide checklist: title, TL;DR slide, 2 benchmark slides (latency/cost), architecture sketch, demo playbook slide. I'll drop draft by Fri EOD.
tahira: rehearsal plan: dry run Wed 9am PT (full run), tech check 30m before live. Please confirm AV needs: presenters need wired ethernet, mics, and screen-share permissions.
emily: speaker ask: @raj (product), @chris (benchmarks), @sam_devrel (demo), @maya_cs (customer panel?) — can everyone confirm availability?
raj: confirmed.
chris: confirmed, will upload assets to drive folder 'webinar/1851234567' and ping here when ready.
tahira: reserved calendar invites for Wed dry run + Tue live. deploy-bot: calendar invite posted: https://calendar.example.com/event/1851234567 (organizer tahira).
emily: lead routing: after signup, route MQLs to sales queue 'webinar-inbound', with tags: product_interest, dedicated_vs_hosted. Tahira, can you own the routing rules and handoff doc?
tahira: will draft routing doc and SLA: respond to MQL within 24h, SDR follow-up in 72h.
chris: small note on messaging: keep benchmark narratives focused on cost-per-token and tail latency — avoid deep LL math. Audience is infra/platform engineers + product.
emily: rehearsal checklist (short): 1) Slides in final folder 2) Demo run + recorded fallback 3) Presenter mic test 4) Lead form & redirect verified 5) Q&A doc with canned answers 6) Recording config
raj: I'll prepare a 90s abstract for landing page: 'How teams balance latency, cost and reliability when serving LLMs — practical patterns from Redwood Inference.' Will post draft here by Thu.
emily: thanks. last asks: everyone add 2 backup sentences to your slides for the moderator to read if a presenter drops. small contingency but saves time.
tahira: noted. see you all at the dry run. :white_check_mark:
